Near Home.title: Litter pick

Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

Near Work.title: Keats House: The Spooky and Sublime John Keats
Near Work.summary: The year turns and the nights draw in, which makes this the perfect moment to join poets Julia Bird and Mike Sims for a social afternoon of readings and conversation exploring the shadowy side of Keats's work. Expect the Gothic thrills of 'La Belle Dame Sans Merci', the ghostly visions of 'Isabella, or The Pot of Basil' and a summoning of the witches and elves which lurk in the corners of his poem
